name: background-lines
title: Background Lines
description: A full-screen dark backdrop scattered with thin coloured curves that draw themselves, drift outward and fade, looping continuously behind whatever content you place on top.
use: A landing hero or quote needs a moving backdrop with nothing to click, especially on a dark theme.
avoid: Continuous random loops cost CPU and never idle, and faint lines wash out on light backgrounds.
a11y: The looping backdrop ignores reduced-motion and is not hidden from assistive tech, so motion cannot be paused. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black panel holds a centred two-line white heading with a small grey paragraph beneath it. Around the text, dozens of fine curved strokes in blue, red, teal, purple and yellow sweep outward like orbits.
behaves: Each stroke draws along its curve, fades and repeats on its own random delay, so arcs forever sprout, travel and dissolve around the still text. Nothing responds to input.
customise: Content is passed as children; a className and an svgOptions.duration prop change the wrapper and stroke speed, while the 42 paths and colours are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: Eighty-four infinitely looping stroke paths animate every frame, though each is cheap.
